description: Report the OFFICIAL J-SHIS 30-year probabilities of reaching each JMA intensity at an address's ~250m mesh, severe case first. These are all-source probabilistic figures published by 地震本部, NOT the Nankai Trough scenario, and they are floors rather than ceilings. This server reports these official values; it does not compute its own.

address.description: Japanese address, or a 7-digit postal code if you cannot type Japanese. e.g. '東京都港区赤坂9-7-1', '高知市本町5', or '232-0063'.
address.title: Address
